name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-core
description: Bindex Core is a Java library and AI function-tool provider for the Machanism AI development ecosystem. It manages Bindex metadata used to describe reusable software artifacts for GenAI-assisted discovery, recommendation, registration, and project assembly workflows. The library exposes AI-callable tools to retrieve Bindex records, filter metadata with GraphQL-style selection queries, recommend libraries from natural-language requirements, register bindex.json descriptors from files, URLs, or direct JSON objects, and load Bindex schema and generation prompts. It includes a Picker service that classifies user prompts with a configured GenAI provider, creates embeddings, performs semantic search, consolidates candidate records, and applies relevance-score thresholds. It includes a BindexRepository abstraction and MongoBindexRepository implementation for MongoDB-backed persistence, lookup, delete, save, and vector-search operations. Bindex Core is designed for Java 17, Maven projects, Ghostwriter CLI, gw-maven-plugin, Machai MCP Server integrations, local or remote MongoDB Bindex repositories, and AI Assembly workflows where agents need reliable library metadata instead of relying only on free-form model knowledge.

usageContext: Expose Bindex operations as AI-callable function tools
Retrieve structured metadata for Maven libraries and other indexed artifacts
Recommend reusable libraries from natural-language project requirements
Register generated or reviewed bindex.json files for semantic discovery
Publish Bindex tools through Machai MCP Server for IDEs and AI assistants
Support Ghostwriter CLI and gw-maven-plugin workflows
Run local development repositories with MongoDB Atlas Local
Support AI Assembly workflows that combine selected libraries into starter projects

constructors.description: Creates an AI function-tool set that exposes Bindex discovery, metadata retrieval, schema retrieval, prompt retrieval, and registration operations to Ghostwriter, MCP, and other GenAI tool-calling runtimes.

examples.description: Instantiate the Bindex function tools provider so a compatible runtime can discover annotated tool methods such as metadata lookup, recommendation, and registration.

constructors.description: Creates a MongoDB-backed Bindex repository using runtime configuration such as BINDEX_REPO_URL, BINDEX_USER, and BINDEX_PASSWORD. Use it when an application needs direct persistence or semantic search access to registered Bindex records.

examples.description: Create the repository with a configured Configurator, read a Bindex record by id, and close the repository with try-with-resources.

constructors.description: Creates a Picker service backed by a Bindex repository and configuration. The Picker registers Bindex records and recommends relevant libraries by classifying natural-language prompts, embedding classification data, and querying the repository with vector search.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository repository = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.MongoBindexRepository(configurator); org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator); java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> libraries = picker.pick("Need AI-callable tools for library metadata lookup and registration", 25L, 0.86d, configurator);
examples.description: Construct a Picker and request library recommendations for a natural-language requirement.

features.name: getBindex
features.signature: public org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex getBindex(java.lang.String id, java.lang.String query, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Retrieves Bindex metadata for a known artifact id or an HTTP or HTTPS URL pointing to a bindex.json descriptor. The optional GraphQL-style query filters the returned JSON structure so agents can request only the fields they need, such as name, version, classification, or supported languages.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools tools = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools(); org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex bindex = tools.getBindex("org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.2.2", "{ name version classification { languages } }", new java.io.File("."), configurator);
examples.description: Look up a registered Bindex record and request only selected metadata fields to reduce response size for an AI agent.

features.name: getRecommendedLibraries
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> getRecommendedLibraries(java.lang.String prompt, double score, int vectorSearchLimits, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Recommends libraries from a natural-language prompt. The feature classifies the request, creates embedding data, searches the Bindex repository, and returns candidate Bindex records whose relevance score is at or above the configured threshold.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools tools = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools(); java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> matches = tools.getRecommendedLibraries("Find a Java library for Bindex metadata registration and MongoDB-backed semantic search", 0.86d, 25, configurator);
examples.description: Ask the tool provider to recommend registered libraries that match a project requirement.

features.name: registerBindex
features.signature: public java.lang.String registerBindex(java.lang.String path, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Registers a Bindex descriptor from a file inside the project directory or from a remote URL. Use it after generating and reviewing bindex.json so the artifact can be discovered and recommended by Bindex-aware tools.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools tools = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools(); java.lang.String recordId = tools.registerBindex("bindex.json", new java.io.File("."), configurator);
examples.description: Register the current project's bindex.json file and receive the repository record identifier.

features.name: registerBindexJson
features.description: Registers an in-memory Bindex object directly, without first reading it from a file. This is useful for automated generation workflows that already hold a structured Bindex payload.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex generated = new org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex(); generated.setId("com.example:example-library:1.0.0"); org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools tools = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools(); java.lang.String recordId = tools.registerBindexJson(generated, configurator);
examples.description: Register a Bindex object assembled by another generation workflow. In real use, populate all required Bindex schema fields before registration.

features.name: pick
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> pick(java.lang.String prompt, long vectorSearchLimits, double score, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Recommends Bindex entries by transforming a user prompt into classification metadata, creating embeddings, querying the repository, and returning candidates above the minimum score. It is the core semantic library-selection operation used by higher-level function tools and AI Assembly workflows.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator); java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> result = picker.pick("Need a Maven-ready library for exposing AI tools through MCP", 25L, 0.86d, configurator);
examples.description: Use the Picker directly when building a custom Java integration that needs Bindex recommendations.

features.name: save
features.description: Saves a Bindex entry through the Picker, generating and storing the embedding vector needed for semantic search. Use this from Java code when you need to register a validated Bindex object programmatically.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator); java.lang.String savedId = picker.save(bindex);
examples.description: Persist a validated Bindex object and its embedding metadata for later discovery.

customizations.name: BINDEX_REPO_URL
customizations.description: MongoDB connection URI used by the Bindex repository. Configure this value to use a local MongoDB Atlas Local instance or a remote MongoDB deployment instead of the default repository URL.

examples.description: Configure bindex-core to use a local MongoDB repository with default Docker credentials.

customizations.name: embedding.model
customizations.description: Embedding model used to create classification vectors for registration and semantic library picking. It should be configured before using registration or recommendation workflows.

examples.description: Set the embedding model when launching a Java process or MCP server.

customizations.name: pick.model
customizations.description: Optional GenAI model used to classify natural-language library-selection prompts. If not set, picker logic can fall back to the general gw.model value.

examples.description: Configure a dedicated model for prompt classification during library recommendation.

customizations.name: picker.classificationInstruction
customizations.description: Prompt template used by recommendation workflows to convert a user request into structured Bindex classification data. Override it when a deployment needs domain-specific classification behavior.

examples.description: Provide a custom instruction template through the runtime Configurator before creating a Picker.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository
studs.description: Repository contract for retrieving, saving, and finding Bindex records. Implement this interface to provide a persistence backend other than MongoDB while keeping Picker and tool integrations unchanged.

examples.snippet: public final class CustomBindexRepository implements org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository { public org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex getBindex(java.lang.String id) { return null; } public java.lang.String save(org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex bindex, java.util.List<java.lang.Double> embedding) { return bindex.getId(); } public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> find(org.machanism.machai.schema.Classification[] classifications, java.util.List<java.lang.Double> embedding, long vectorSearchLimits, double score, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator config) { return java.util.Collections.emptyList(); } }
examples.description: Implement the repository contract to plug in custom storage or search infrastructure.

examples.title: Install bindex-core in a Maven project
examples.scenario: Use Bindex Core directly from Java code to access repository and picker APIs.
steps: Add the Maven dependency to your pom.xml.
Configure repository and model settings through environment variables, system properties, or the Machanism Configurator.
Instantiate MongoBindexRepository and Picker or use BindexFunctionTools through a compatible tool runtime.
examples.explanation: This example installs the library as a normal Maven dependency and uses fully qualified Java classes to recommend matching Bindex records from a natural-language prompt.

examples.title: Run Bindex tools through the Machai MCP Server
examples.scenario: Expose Bindex Core as MCP function tools for clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code with GitHub Copilot, JetBrains IDEs, Zed, or Warp.
steps: Download machai-mcp-server.jar from the Machai MCP Server releases.
Download bindex-core.jar from the Bindex Core releases.
Set GenAI credentials and model configuration.
Start the MCP server with both JAR files on the classpath.
Configure your MCP-compatible client to connect to the server port.
examples.explanation: Adding bindex-core.jar to the Machai MCP Server classpath publishes Bindex function tools for metadata retrieval, library picking, and record registration. On Windows, use a semicolon instead of a colon as the classpath separator.

examples.title: Use bindex-core with gw-maven-plugin
examples.scenario: Make Bindex tools available to Ghostwriter Maven workflows, including Bindex generation and registration acts.
steps: Add gw-maven-plugin to the Maven build.
Add bindex-core as a plugin dependency.
Configure gw.model and embedding.model if your workflow performs recommendation or registration.
Run the desired Ghostwriter act from Maven or your configured automation.
examples.explanation: The plugin dependency makes Bindex Core tools and acts available to Maven-based Ghostwriter automation.

examples.title: Run a local Bindex repository with Dockerized MongoDB
examples.scenario: Develop and test Bindex registration and recommendation without using a remote repository.
steps: Open the Docker Compose directory at src/docker/mongodb.
Start MongoDB Atlas Local with docker compose up -d.
Use MongoDB Compass to connect to mongodb://user:pass@localhost:27017/?authSource=admin&appName=machanism if inspection is needed.
Set BINDEX_REPO_URL, BINDEX_USER, and BINDEX_PASSWORD before running Bindex Core workflows.
examples.commands:
cd src/docker/mongodb
docker compose up -d
export BINDEX_REPO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/?appName=machanism
export BINDEX_USER=user
export BINDEX_PASSWORD=pass
examples.explanation: The local repository is useful for development, validation, and isolated registration tests. The initialization script configures the machanism database and bindex collection.
